entry.summary: An agent working on production systems needs permission to act. A request like “fix this deployment” doesn’t tell you upfront which actions it will take or what access it will need. Grant agents broad
entry.content: An agent working on production systems needs permission to act. A request like “fix this deployment” doesn’t tell you upfront which actions it will take or what access it will need. Grant agents broad access and a mistake can affect unrelated resources. Ask for approval at every step and the user has to approve individual actions before they know how the agent intends to solve the problem.
